headline.text: L2 FFS and L3 TG5 both down at window close — FFS tracking failure at 07:12, TG5 damaged belt at 07:01.

per_plant_summary.L1: L1 S3 had an air fitting issue from Friday night that blocked tray printing setup; maintenance resolved it by 05:44 and the line started at 06:35. S4 completed routine sanitization and prep.
per_plant_summary.L2: L2 ML2 had two quick stops — a mold temperature sensor issue (cleared in 7 minutes) and a vacuum blowout (cleared in 14 minutes). FFS went down at 07:12 with a tracking problem and was still down at window close.
per_plant_summary.L3: L3 ML4 had a discharge belt jam that cleared by 06:47, but TG5 went down at 07:01 on a damaged metal detector belt and is waiting for maintenance. The line also has dirty molds causing candy exposure on roughly 1 in 3 bars; crew is pulling affected product and cycling clean molds through (60-75 minute process).

notes.text: Alan Todd reports ML2 will finish the Crunch order on first shift Monday then clean; ML3 will clean Monday and start HER Caramel on first shift Tuesday.
ML2 first shift shadow board is missing wrench #13.

resolved.title: S3 air fitting mismatch blocked tray printer setup
resolved.summary: L3 maintenance swapped air line fittings to wrong size on Friday; L1's hoses didn't fit and blocked tray printing for Macadamia run.
resolved.resolution: Maintenance installed correct 3/8 fittings and restored air by 05:44 — "Air Fitting are install and air is on" (Lolo Bencomo). Line started at 06:35.

resolved.title: ML2 mold temperature sensor causing deposit skips
resolved.summary: Depositor stopped at 05:29 because many molds were flagged with temperature problems and the system was skipping deposits.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 05:37 — "Maintenance cleaned the sensor that reads the mold temp. We are depositing on every mold now" (Alex Mendoza).

resolved.title: ML2 vacuum blowout stopped the line
resolved.summary: Flow wrap line stopped at 06:03 when the vacuum system blew out.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 06:17 — "Line back up running" (ML2 FW).

resolved.title: ML4 discharge belt and aligner both stopped
resolved.summary: At 06:30 the discharge belt stopped moving and the aligner stopped separating product at demolding.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 06:47 — "This has been resolved" (Itzel Chavez).

needs_attention.title: FFS tracking failure took the line down
needs_attention.summary: VFFS line went down at 07:12 with a tracking problem; no resolution posted by window close.
needs_attention.status: Line down as of 07:12; no updates on cause or ETA.

needs_attention.title: ML4 TG5 metal detector belt damaged and ripping
needs_attention.summary: The metal detector belt on TG5 is damaged and tearing; TG5 is down waiting for maintenance to inspect.
needs_attention.status: TG5 down as of 07:02, waiting for maintenance inspection.

needs_attention.title: ML4 dirty molds causing candy exposure on 1 in 3 bars
needs_attention.summary: Dirty molds were left in the preheating cabinet marked as good over the weekend; approximately one bar per three molds has candy exposure and is being hand-pulled.
needs_attention.status: Crew is cycling out dirty molds and pulling affected bars; full cycle will take 60-75 minutes from 07:08.
